altTexts: The Inscribe workspace with the File sub-tab selected
The file input with size and estimated cost area
The fee and review sections for a file inscription
stepInstructions: Select the File sub-tab. The form accepts images, audio, video, models, and other binary content.
Choose a file. Cost scales with size: the quote area shows the reveal fee growing with bytes.
Review the fee tier and the quote before paying. Large files are expensive at high fee rates: read the number.
